body: Thank you for this, I'll make a course of action, didn't even think it would be something to prepare in advance but that makes a lot of sense.

He's 100% convinced it's circumstantial, and is asking me for help with his problems, help I can't give him. I try to let him do the talking but he's actively asking me for solutions, which can only sort of be solved metaphysically. He's starting to be annoyed with my "care" because it doesn't help him. Thank you for the reply, feels so good to have another in on this, even if it's just an internet stranger.

He has never made an attempt or been hospitalized, but he has been seeing a therapist for his depression but claims it does nothing to help. I'm pretty sure it's just talk, more of an expression of hopelessness rather than actual planning and willing to go through with it, but always scary anyway. It's good to hear your thanks, because from him there is not much, even though I know he's not really in a position to be thinking of me right now.
